children: Catalyst Acquisition Corp. reported a net loss for the three months ended June 30, 2026, with a net loss of $(33,679) and diluted loss per Class B share of $(0.01). For the six months ended June 30, 2026, the company recorded a net loss of $(77,558) and diluted loss per Class B share of $(0.02).
Net income: $(33,679) for 2Q 2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026); $(77,558) for 1H 2026 (six months ended June 30, 2026).
Diluted EPS: $(0.01) for 2Q 2026; $(0.02) for 1H 2026 (basic and diluted net loss per Class B share).
IPO and capital formation: Completed an IPO on July 29, 2026, raising $200.0M plus an $11.5M overallotment and a $2.7M sponsor placement to fund the search for a business combination.
Strategic focus: Targeting traditional and digital media, including video games, mobile gaming, publishers, studios and media platforms.
Operational readiness: Established a trustee-held $211.5M trust to be used for an acquisition and put administrative services in place for post-IPO operations.
Activity and outlook: No operating revenue to date; management expects higher public-company expenses going forward and continues diligence on potential business combination targets.
Timing and execution risk: The company has a 24-month Combination Period to complete a business combination, with possible extension subject to shareholder approval.
